# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.9 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.8. Everything below is command-line; the window is unchanged.

**Text and OCR**
- `--clean-text` (Romanian clean-up: comma-below s/t, de-hyphenation, quotes), `--page-lang` (language per page), `--ocr-cache DIR`, `--ocr-mode skip|redo|force`.
- Lone page numbers that Tesseract leaves out are read again (12 real Romanian pages: CER unchanged at 15.2 %, no new errors).
- Output: `--alto`, `--page-xml`, `--tei`, `--tables-xlsx`, `--tables-html`.

**Library and checks**
- `--quality-report`, `--explain`, `--verify-text`, `--certify`, `--scan-active`, `--burst`, `--page-labels`, `--bookmarks-headings`, `--catalog`, `--dublin-core`, `{title}` in file names, fuzzy `--search-query`.

**Archive**
- `--pdfa-part 1|2|3`: veraPDF on CI passes 2b (7 of 7 samples), 1b (3 of 3) and 3b (3 of 3).
- `--bagit` / `--verify-bag`, `--merkle-root` / `--merkle-proof` / `--merkle-verify`, `--provenance`, `--backup-from` / `--backup-to`, rights notice from the author's death year with assignment deed fields.
- Releases now carry `SHA256SUMS.txt` and a CycloneDX SBOM; `SECURITY.md` added.

**Tools**
- PDF toolbox on existing PDFs: `--merge-pdf`, `--extract-pages`, `--split-pdf-every`, `--watermark`, `--number-pages`.
- `--efactura FILE`: key fields and arithmetic / CUI checks of an e-Factura invoice.
- `--watch DIR`, `--max-memory MB` (12 A4 pages at 600 dpi: 484 MB -> 239 MB, 12.3 s -> 19.5 s).

**Tested and not shipped** (numbers in ROADMAP.md): word-level ensemble of two engines, dictionary correction, a per-page error estimate from confidences. None improved the measured error.

Not solved: no hand-verified reference text exists yet (CER is measured on 12 real pages and a synthetic set); ALTO / PAGE / TEI are checked for well-formedness only; the e-Factura reader was tried on one hand-written sample; PDF/UA tagging, PAdES signing and release signing are not done; Windows/macOS/ARM builds are CI-only; GUI tested by hand on Linux only.
